name: circuit-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the circuit design verification for the checked-in board project in the workspace. Run `/circuit:erc <schematic.kicad_sch>` and `/circuit:drc <board.kicad_pcb>` plus the connectivity gate on the project's design files, compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the design report, and write a short result to observations/circuit/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
